title: Tool Box shortcuts, selected-text popups, and OCR translation
dependency: OCR Popup Settings PR #18 when independently verified

acceptance.case: Validate and persist customizable global shortcuts for opening the Tool Box, OCR, Grammar and Translate. Keep existing defaults, reject duplicate/unsupported chords, and surface shortcuts owned by other apps.
Open Tool Box immediately with a visible app control and the configurable shortcut, including when already open. Exercise rebinding, conflicts and persistence on Windows.

Physical selection then Translate shortcut opens a dedicated selected-text popup, prefills the selection, submits once and exposes copy. No selection opens a usable manual input. Dashboard Translate route also works.
OCR shortcut creates the existing anchored capture. Its Translate action translates detected text inline without opening a second popup. Copy source and translation independently.

Grammar shortcut and dashboard control open a usable tool. Grammar popup stays visibly above an overlapping regular app after external click without reclaiming focus; explicit Close and Escape still work.

gate.rule: Only mark passed and merge after exact product Advisor review, automated checks and independent real Windows UI evidence.
